	# Culture 260: Jutribocian -> Nicipsian (Nikitzen)
	every_culture_global = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { this = title:c_barcelona.culture }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = tarr_culture }
				NOT = { this = global_var:tarr_culture }
			}
			has_cultural_pillar = heritage_west_slavic
			has_cultural_pillar = language_lechitic
			has_cultural_pillar = ethos_egalitarian
			has_cultural_tradition = tradition_hereditary_hierarchy
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = tarr_direct_mode }
			set_culture_name = {
				noun = tarr_culture_260_tarr_name
				collective_noun = tarr_culture_260_tarr_collective
				prefix = tarr_culture_260_tarr_prefix
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_culture_name = {
				noun = tarr_culture_260_name
				collective_noun = tarr_culture_260_collective
				prefix = tarr_culture_260_prefix
			}
		}
	}

	# =========================================================================
	# House 16793861: Restore Suerbeer (previously overwritten by Berezina)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = tarr_pin_16793861 } }
		title:c_berlin.holder ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = house
					house = { NOT = { has_variable = tarr_house_tag } }
					NOR = {
						dynasty ?= dynasty:667
						dynasty ?= dynasty:25061
						dynasty ?= dynasty:656
						dynasty ?= dynasty:100217
						dynasty ?= dynasty:9116
						dynasty ?= dynasty:7198
						dynasty ?= dynasty:597
						dynasty ?= dynasty:9217
						dynasty ?= dynasty:1029002
						dynasty ?= dynasty:836
						dynasty ?= dynasty:830
						dynasty ?= dynasty:4039
					}
				}
				house = {
					set_house_name = dynn_Suerbeer
					set_variable = { name = tarr_house_tag value = flag:suerbeer }
				}
				dynasty ?= { set_dynasty_name = dynn_Suerbeer }
				set_global_variable = { name = tarr_pin_16793861 value = yes }
			}
		}
		title:c_novosil.holder ?= {

					dynasty ?= { set_dynasty_name = tarr_house_itze }
					set_global_variable = { name = tarr_pin_50349259 value = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# House 17334: Jihlava -> Rokytna (via c_bornholm spouse)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = tarr_pin_17334 } }
		title:c_bornholm.holder.primary_spouse ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = house
					house = { NOT = { has_variable = tarr_house_tag } }
					NOR = {
						dynasty ?= dynasty:667
						dynasty ?= dynasty:25061
						dynasty ?= dynasty:656
						dynasty ?= dynasty:100217
						dynasty ?= dynasty:9116
						dynasty ?= dynasty:7198
						dynasty ?= dynasty:597
						dynasty ?= dynasty:9217
						dynasty ?= dynasty:1029002
						dynasty ?= dynasty:836
						dynasty ?= dynasty:830
						dynasty ?= dynasty:4039
					}
				}
				house = {
					set_house_name = tarr_house_rokytna
					set_variable = { name = tarr_house_tag value = flag:rokytna }
				}
				dynasty ?= { set_dynasty_name = tarr_house_rokytna }
				set_global_variable = { name = tarr_pin_17334 value = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	# House 16801742: Brunnsholm-Sebezh -> Brunnsholm-Sebêsch (courtier at b_sheffield)
	if = {

		title:b_sheffield.holder ?= {
			every_courtier_or_guest = {

							dynasty ?= dynasty:656

							dynasty ?= dynasty:4039

						is_house_head = yes
						is_female = yes
					}
					house = {
						set_house_name = tarr_house_brunnsholm_sebesch
						set_variable = { name = tarr_house_tag value = flag:brunnsholm_sebesch }
					}
					set_global_variable = { name = tarr_pin_16801742 value = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# House 16800196 & 33569509: Soundavara-Obnore (spouse of c_scalovia) & Soundavara-Erkawîka (male house_head)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = tarr_pin_16800196 } }
		title:c_scalovia.holder.primary_spouse ?= {

				}
				house = {
					set_house_name = tarr_house_soundavara_obnore
					set_variable = { name = tarr_house_tag value = flag:soundavara_obnore }

				dynasty ?= {
					every_dynasty_member = {
						limit = {
							is_alive = yes
							is_house_head = yes
							is_male = yes

						}
						house = {
							set_house_name = tarr_house_soundavara_erkawika
							set_variable = { name = tarr_house_tag value = flag:soundavara_erkawika }
						}
						set_global_variable = { name = tarr_pin_33569509 value = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# House 23369: Sheksna-Kholmogory -> Sheksna-Dwina (HRE noble family domicile c_qaraustyurt)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = tarr_pin_23369 } }
		title:h_roman_empire.holder ?= {
			every_noble_family = {
				limit = {
					holder ?= {
						is_alive = yes
						exists = domicile
						domicile.domicile_location.county ?= title:c_qaraustyurt
						exists = house
						house = { NOT = { has_variable = tarr_house_tag } }
					}
				}
				holder ?= {
					house = {
						set_house_name = tarr_house_sheksna_dwina
						set_variable = { name = tarr_house_tag value = flag:sheksna_dwina }
					}
					set_global_variable = { name = tarr_pin_23369 value = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = tarr_v2_collateral_fix_applied value = yes }
